ACo.caption: Template ID
ACo.doc: Starts with 'tpl_'. Find it in your DocSpring account, or with Find Templates.
ACo.name: templateId

ACp.caption: Template Version
ACp.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
ACp.name: version

ACq.caption: Data
ACq.doc: The values of the template's fields, by field name. Use '/' for nested fields and lists, such as 'address/city' or 'items/0/name'. Date fields take dates as YYYY-MM-DD. For an image field, use 'image_name/url' with an image URL.
ACq.name: data

ACr.caption: Enable Booleans
ACr.doc: If enabled, any fields with the exact value of "true" or "false" will be parsed as booleans (true and false) instead of as text.
ACr.name: parseAsBoolean

ACs.caption: Test Mode
ACs.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. A test API token always makes test PDFs.
ACs.name: test

ACt.caption: Signature Requests (JSON)
ACt.doc: Optional. A JSON list of signature requests to check with the data, as in Create Signature Request's More Signers (JSON).
ACt.name: signatureRequests
